Seyi Makinde and his running mate Lawal Daura ahead of the 2027 general elections in Bauchi state.
The campaign flag-off is scheduled to be held on Saturday at the Abubakar Tafawa Balewa Memorial in Bauchi metropolis.
The event is expected to attract a large gathering of APM members, supporters and political stakeholders from across the country as the party seeks to build momentum for its presidential campaign.
The gathering will provide a platform for the party’s presidential and vice-presidential candidates to present their messages of hope and national renewal, while outlining their vision for a better Nigeria.
Other prominent political figures expected at the event will also address the gathering and reaffirm their commitment to the party’s campaign and its proposed agenda for the country.
Ahead of the flag-off, Makinde is expected to engage directly with Nigerians through a live radio interview and interactive session on the Bauchi Radio Corporation (BRC).
The programme, which will also be streamed live across the organisation’s social media platforms, is scheduled for Friday, November 6, 2026, between 6pm and 8pm.
The interactive session will give listeners an opportunity to ask questions and hear directly from the presidential candidate on his plans, policy priorities and agenda for Nigeria ahead of the 2027 elections.
The campaign will serve as an early test of the party’s mobilisation capacity and its ability to translate political alliances, grassroots support and organisational structures into a credible nationwide presidential campaign.
